headline: Novartis India shares surge 10 percent in market trade
hook: Sudden buying interest boosts Novartis India
summary: Novartis India shares experienced a sharp rally, jumping 10% in recent trading sessions. The sudden surge has drawn investor attention to the multinational pharmaceutical company's stock. While the exact immediate trigger for the rally was not detailed, the stock's movement reflects strong buying interest. Retail investors holding the stock see a quick bump in their portfolio value.
why_it_matters: Novartis shareholders see a quick ten percent portfolio bump
